@graph.name: FarmTree
@graph.description: FarmTree helps organisations plan, compare, monitor and report agroforestry investments with science-based project intelligence.

acceptedAnswer.text: FarmTree connects production, carbon, hydrology, soil fertility, labour and economics in one science-based model.
Yes. Project teams can turn site data and species assumptions into comparable scenarios and structured investment plans.

mainEntity.name: How far ahead can FarmTree project?

acceptedAnswer.text: FarmTree supports projections of up to 50 years for long-term planning, investment cases and project monitoring.

mainEntity.name: What information is needed to get started?

acceptedAnswer.text: The starting point depends on the project, but typically combines a location and site baseline with species, management and economic assumptions.

mainEntity.name: Are FarmTree results measurements or projections?

acceptedAnswer.text: FarmTree produces modelled projections from the inputs and assumptions supplied. They should be interpreted alongside measured field data and the documented scenario context.

mainEntity.name: Can FarmTree compare different project scenarios?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Teams can compare species mixes, management choices and other project assumptions to understand potential trade-offs before selecting a plan.

mainEntity.name: Can FarmTree connect with other reporting systems?

acceptedAnswer.text: Data exchange and reporting options depend on the required workflow and system and should be scoped with the FarmTree team.

mainEntity.name: How do we request a demo?

acceptedAnswer.text: Request a demo and the FarmTree team will follow up to discuss your project context, scope and reporting needs.
